title: Ijwi ry'Ukwemera Kwihishijwe
intro: Mu mutima w’urukiko rw’ububisha, aho ukutemera kwari itegeko ry’igihugu, umutima uri wenyene waragenda umugozi ukomeye w’ukwizera n’ubwoba. Uwo muntu, yari hafi y’aho ububasha bushingiye, yarumviriza igihe ubutumwa bw’umuhanuzi bwashikirwa n’agasuzuguro n’ugutera ubwoba. Igihe c’ukuri carashitse, kigobera uwo muntu guhitamwo hagati yo kwikingira mu gacerere no kuvuga ukuri guteye akaga. Woba ushobora guhishura uwo muvugizi w’intwari uwo ari we?
clues: Nabaye mu rugo rw’umunyagitugu nyene, nkibonera ubwanje ubwibone bwanka ibimenyetso vy’Imana.
Ukwemera kwanje nagumye ari ibanga, ubutunzi bwanyegejwe mu ngoro y’ugusenga ibigirwamana.
Numva umurongozi nakorera agira umugambi wo kwica intumwa ya Allah, umuntu yitwa Musa.
Narashidikanya ku vyerekeye ivyiyumviro vyabo, ndabibutsa iherezo ry’abantu b’i Nuh, Ad na Thamud.
Nabajije abantu banje ikibazo gikomeye cane: ‘Nimba ari umubeshi, ikinyoma ciwe kiri kuri we; ariko nimba ari umunyakuri, bimwe mu vyo asezerana bizokukubita.’
Inkuru yanje ivugwa nk’akarorero k’ukwizera muri sura yitwa ‘Umubabazi,’ aho nagabishije abantu banje ku migambi y’abanyabubasha.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
